Thanksgiving by bush plane. 🦃✈️

On November 22, pilot Heidi Hastings and volunteer Esther Keim flew their final Thanksgiving delivery of the season in Alaska. Keim told KTUU the team delivered 42 turkeys this season to households across the West Susitna area and beyond.

The bags carried a few extras, too, including instant coffee and caramels. For neighbors living off the road system, that little airplane brought dinner and a reminder that someone was thinking of them. Here’s to the crew and the volunteers who made those flights happen.
